_comment: E03-T04: per-package coverage floors and ratchet baselines. Floors are the hard, never-lowered standard from docs/plan/30-release-roadmap.md §4.4 / docs/plan/03-testing-strategy.md §2. Baselines start equal to the floor and only ratchet upward (never down) via the baseline-raise bot PR. Lowering a baseline requires a hand-edited commit with a 'Reason:' line and CODEOWNER (QA lead) approval — see CODEOWNERS entry for this file. branch_floor/branch_baseline (#3691) judge branch coverage the same way for the packages CONSTITUTION §9 #3 and C-13.1 give a 75% branch floor; the ratchet raises line baselines only.
